skill.name: set-up-woocommerce-chatgpt-ads-conversions-api
skill.description: Set up server-side ChatGPT Ads conversion tracking for WooCommerce through Product Metrics and the OpenAI Conversions API. Check setup status, configure consent, and verify delivery with a paid test order.
skill.summary: Connect WooCommerce to ChatGPT Ads and verify server-side conversion delivery.
skill.author: product-metrics

security_audit.summary: Most static matches are documentation or routine setup reads, with no evidence of host reconnaissance or prompt injection. Confirmed risks involve authenticated MCP access, writes without an approval check, broad order lookups, and an unpinned installer. The workflow also leaves gaps in API key handling, approval for historical imports, and disclosure before enabling event forwarding.

remediation.issue: The command workflow can expose a Conversions API key to the assistant or command runtime.
remediation.suggestion: Remove the credential exception and direct users to the write-only Product Metrics form. Never pass the key through chat or command arguments.

remediation.issue: Setup writes can change live configuration without an explicit approval check.
remediation.suggestion: Before each write, show the company, property, destination and intended change. Require approval and use scoped permissions for the CLI and MCP.

remediation.issue: The initial import can transfer historical orders to Product Metrics without a clear scope or a separate approval.
remediation.suggestion: Explain which historical orders and fields will be imported and where they go. Obtain separate approval before starting the import.

remediation.issue: The default save step can enable event forwarding before the workflow reviews consent or discloses the fields sent.
remediation.suggestion: Verify consent settings and show the event fields, destination, and opt-out controls before enabling forwarding. Ask the merchant to approve the transfer.

remediation.issue: Verification can list recent production orders that are unrelated to the test.
remediation.suggestion: Look up the known test order in the selected store and return only delivery status. Avoid listing recent orders by default.

remediation.issue: The optional installer does not pin the package runner or skill source.
remediation.suggestion: Pin the installer package version and skill source revision. Keep installation user-initiated and explain what it downloads and changes.

semantic_findings.title: Conflicting API Key Handling Instructions
semantic_findings.description: The main rules allow receiving the Conversions API key from the merchant and passing it directly to a command. The reference says never to paste it into chat. Following the exception can expose the key to conversation records or command telemetry.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The main rule explicitly creates a credential exception, while the reference requires direct entry. No evidence shows that a key was actually disclosed.

semantic_findings.title: Historical Order Import Without Separate Approval
semantic_findings.description: The WooCommerce guide directs merchants to queue an initial order import into Product Metrics after a configuration check. It does not state the historical range or require separate approval for importing existing customer orders.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The WooCommerce guide explicitly queues an import but does not define its scope. The no-backfill statement applies to ChatGPT Ads, not Product Metrics.

semantic_findings.title: Event Forwarding Enabled Before Consent Review
semantic_findings.description: The guide saves the destination with sending enabled before reviewing consent settings. For stores with existing marketing consent, events may already include hashed identifiers, IP addresses, and browser details. The setup step does not disclose those fields.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The forwarding toggle is left on before the consent step, and the guide lists the transferred fields. The documented consent gate still applies.

content.user_title: Set Up WooCommerce Tracking for ChatGPT Ads
content.value_statement: Browser-only tracking can miss WooCommerce purchases. This skill guides server-side conversion setup through Product Metrics and helps you verify that a consented test purchase reaches ChatGPT Ads.
actual_capabilities: Reads Product Metrics setup status through the CLI or MCP and identifies incomplete steps.
Guides plugin setup, paid order status selection, and linking WooCommerce to a Product Metrics property.
Guides adding the ChatGPT Ads destination and checking the Pixel ID and API key validation status.
Explains which WooCommerce consent banners are supported and how marketing consent affects delivery.
Separates store delivery verification from Ads Manager delivery and explains how to check both.
Explains purchase, cart, checkout, and custom value events, including how browser pixel deduplication works.
limitations: Requires Product Metrics Pro, editor or admin access, WordPress administrator access, and access to Ads Manager.
Requires WordPress 6.4 or later, PHP 8.1 or later, active WP-Cron, and an HTTPS store at the domain root.
ChatGPT Ads does not import historical WooCommerce orders through this workflow. Events older than seven days are rejected, and later refunds do not revise sent events.
The merchant handles WordPress and Ads Manager steps. Customer matching and bidding setup are outside this skill.

use_cases.title: Plan a first store connection
use_cases.description: Check store requirements and identify the manual steps needed to link WooCommerce and ChatGPT Ads.

use_cases.title: Diagnose missing purchase events
use_cases.description: Compare paid order status, consent settings, and destination delivery before testing another purchase.

use_cases.title: Check a parallel browser pixel
use_cases.description: Review how event IDs prevent duplicate counts when the OpenAI Pixel runs alongside server-side delivery.

prompt_templates.title: Check the prerequisites
prompt_templates.scenario: You are planning your first connection.
prompt_templates.prompt: List the accounts, permissions, and store requirements for WooCommerce conversion tracking with ChatGPT Ads. Do not change settings or ask for credentials.

prompt_templates.title: Review an existing connection
prompt_templates.scenario: Your store is already linked to Product Metrics.
prompt_templates.prompt: Check setup status for my selected store and property. Tell me what is missing and which steps I should complete in the app.

prompt_templates.title: Verify a test purchase
prompt_templates.scenario: You can place a consented test order.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me verify one paid test order in WooCommerce and ChatGPT Ads. Use only that order and explain the difference between key validation and event delivery.

prompt_templates.title: Review consent and deduplication
prompt_templates.scenario: You already use the browser pixel.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review consent requirements and event ID deduplication for purchase, cart, and checkout events. Identify which changes need developer review without changing the live configuration.

output_examples.input: The app says OpenAI accepted the test event. Is live tracking verified?
output: The connection check validates the Pixel ID and key. It does not create a reporting event.
Run one paid test order with marketing consent. Check live order delivery in WooCommerce and the destination delivery counts in Product Metrics.

output_examples.input: My purchase tracking works, but cart events count twice.
output: Purchase deduplication uses the transaction ID. Cart and checkout events need the same event ID in the browser and server copies.
Have your developer check that the browser pixel receives the event ID returned by Product Metrics.

best_practices: Enter API keys in the Product Metrics app and setup tokens in WordPress Admin. Keep both out of chat.
Confirm the intended store, property, pixel, and consent settings before enabling event forwarding.
Use a known test order and check both WooCommerce delivery status and the ChatGPT Ads destination.
anti_patterns: Do not treat API key validation as proof that a live conversion reached Ads Manager.
Do not import historical orders into Product Metrics without checking the import scope. This does not import past orders into ChatGPT Ads.
Do not bypass consent or change which conversion a live campaign uses to troubleshoot delivery.

faq.question: Do I need Product Metrics?
faq.answer: Yes. This workflow uses Product Metrics Pro and the Product Metrics for WooCommerce plugin.

faq.question: Where do I enter the Conversions API key?
faq.answer: Create it in ChatGPT Ads Manager under Conversions and enter it in the Product Metrics app. Do not paste it into chat.

faq.question: Which consent banners are supported?
faq.answer: The WooCommerce guide lists OneTrust, Cookiebot, Usercentrics, and Osano. The workflow does not send ChatGPT Ads events without marketing consent.

faq.question: Can I keep my existing OpenAI Pixel?
faq.answer: Yes. Purchase deduplication uses the order transaction ID. Cart and checkout events require matching event IDs in the browser and server copies.

faq.question: Why did my paid test order not appear?
faq.answer: Check the paid order status, marketing consent, and delivery status in Product Metrics. A successful connection check does not appear as a reported conversion.

faq.question: Will past orders or later refunds update ChatGPT Ads?
faq.answer: Past orders are not imported into ChatGPT Ads, and later refunds do not revise events already sent.
